summary: WeRide Inc. (Hong Kong and Nasdaq-listed) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return under Listing Rules 13.25A/17.27A, reporting ordinary share repurchases on May 19-20, 2026. The issuer bought back 540,000 ADS-equivalent shares on Nasdaq at USD 2.2316/share and 1,681,500 shares on HKEX at HKD 17.8245/share, both held as treasury shares. This is a routine disclosure of open-market buybacks, not a formal tender offer or capital return program announcement. No recommendation, premium, or structural terms are provided. Equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K disclosure of share repurchases, this filing does not trigger a special-situation categorization.
